desc: Implement cycle detection by indegree peeling and construct reverse-child lists excluding cycle-to-cycle edges.
Compute non-cycle subtree DP arrays in an order where all children are processed first.
Evaluate each cycle component by multiplying attached-child prefix contributions and summing over values \(1,\dots,M\).
Handle self-loops, short cycles, multiple components, and modular arithmetic.
Produce the complete stdin/stdout Python solution with \(O(NM)\) time and memory-conscious storage.
